starterCode.python:
from datetime import datetime
from typing import Any

from passlib.context import CryptContext
from pydantic import BaseModel, model_validator

# https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/tutorial/security/oauth2-jwt/
# which we'll further explore in a later Bite
pwd_context = CryptContext(schemes=["bcrypt"], deprecated="auto")


def get_password_hash(password):
    return pwd_context.hash(password)


class Food(BaseModel):
    """Bite 02"""

    id: int
    name: str
    serving_size: str
    kcal_per_serving: int
    protein_grams: float
    fibre_grams: float = 0


# Write the User and FoodEntry models here ...

# === SUPPLIED FASTAPI TESTS ===
# Keep the tests and adapter unchanged.
_FA_MODULE = 'models'
_FA_IDS = ['test_create_user_object', 'test_create_incomplete_user_object', 'test_create_user_object_wrong_type', 'test_create_food_log_object', 'test_create_food_missing_data', 'test_added_date_defaults_at_each_creation']
_FA_TESTS = r'''
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

import pytest
from pydantic import ValidationError

from models import Food, FoodEntry, User, pwd_context

LAME_PASSWORD = "1234"  # noqa S105


# also from https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/tutorial/security/oauth2-jwt/
def _verify_password(plain_password, hashed_password):
    return pwd_context.verify(plain_password, hashed_password)


@pytest.fixture
def user():
    user = User(id=1, username="user1", password=LAME_PASSWORD)
    return user


@pytest.fixture
def food():
    food = Food(
        id=1,
        name="egg",
        serving_size="piece",
        kcal_per_serving=78,
        protein_grams=6.3,
        fibre_grams=0,
    )
    return food


def test_create_user_object(user):
    assert type(user) == User
    assert user.id == 1
    assert user.username == "user1"
    assert _verify_password(LAME_PASSWORD, user.password) is True


def test_create_incomplete_user_object():
    error = "username\n  Field required"
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError, match=error):
        User(id=1, password="abc")


def test_create_user_object_wrong_type():
    error = "id\n  Input should be a valid integer"
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError, match=error):
        User(id="1abc", username="user1", password="abc")


def test_create_food_log_object(user, food):
    food_entry = FoodEntry(id=1, user=user, food=food, number_servings=1.5)
    now = datetime.now()
    assert abs(food_entry.date_added - now) < timedelta(seconds=10)
    assert food_entry.user == user
    assert food_entry.food == food
    assert food_entry.number_servings == 1.5
    assert food_entry.total_calories == 1.5 * 78


def test_create_food_missing_data(user, food):
    error = "user\n  Field required"
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError, match=error):
        FoodEntry(id=1, food=food, number_servings=1.5)

# Added Cojudge boundary tests.

def test_added_date_defaults_at_each_creation(user, food):
    import time
    from datetime import datetime
    first = FoodEntry(id=10, user=user, food=food, number_servings=2)
    time.sleep(0.02)
    second = FoodEntry(id=11, user=user, food=food, number_servings=0.5)
    assert second.date_added > first.date_added
    explicit = datetime(2020, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5)
    item = FoodEntry(id=12, user=user, food=food, number_servings=0, date_added=explicit)
    assert item.date_added == explicit
    assert item.total_calories == 0
'''


class Solution:
    def run(self, payload: str) -> str:
        import json
        import os
        from pathlib import Path
        import subprocess
        import sys
        import tempfile

        test = json.loads(payload)['test']
        if test not in _FA_IDS:
            return 'Unknown test: ' + str(test)
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='fastapi-bite-') as work:
            source = Path(__file__).read_text().split('# === SUPPLIED FASTAPI TESTS ===', 1)[0]
            Path(work, _FA_MODULE + '.py').write_text(source)
            Path(work, 'test_bite.py').write_text(_FA_TESTS)
            env = dict(os.environ, PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD='1', PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1')
            try:
                done = subprocess.run(
                    [sys.executable, '-m', 'pytest', '-q', '--tb=short', '--disable-warnings',
                     '-p', 'no:cacheprovider', 'test_bite.py::' + test],
                    cwd=work, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=12)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                return 'FAILED ' + test + ' | Test exceeded 12 seconds'
            if done.returncode == 0:
                return 'passed'
            output = done.stdout + done.stderr
            lines = [line.strip() for line in output.splitlines() if line.strip()]
            return ('FAILED ' + test + ' | ' + ' | '.join(lines))[:6000]
